_convergence_criteria.description: HARDENED gate (hardened_gate_enabled=true). Converged iff, on the SETTLED post-reconciliation registry critical/structural series: (A) gamma_critical >= 0.30 AND (B) sustained over 2 consecutive settled recomputes AND leave-one-round-out robust within 0.05, AND (C) 3 consecutive settled rounds with zero novel critical findings. Sparsity fallback: if cumulative critical < 8 closure rests on (C) alone, gamma_critical reported-not-gated. All-severity gamma is logged as a diagnostic only and NEVER gates. Conjunction, not the legacy OR.
_convergence_criteria.pass_condition: (gamma_crit>=0.30 sustained+loo-robust AND 3r zero-novel-critical) OR (sparsity fallback: cum_crit<8 AND 3r zero-novel-critical).
_convergence_criteria.fail_condition: Any model fails to produce parseable output in 2+ consecutive rounds.
